data.long_meaning: Derived from the Slavic word 'idu' (to go) and 'syn' (son). Translates to 'fighter's son' or 'warrior's son'. The name Idzik carries the meaning “Fighter's son” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Idzik usually hope their child will grow to embody fighter's son and live with faith, good character and purpose.

in_english.name: Idzik
in_english.long_meaning: From the Old English 'id' which means 'to fight' and 'zik' which means 'struggle' or 'contend'. This name is derived from the root 'id-' which means 'a fighter' or 'a warrior'.
